description: This source file provides utility functions for managing local heavy check runtime behavior, including environment configuration, command-line argument modifications, lock acquisition, and synchronization, primarily used in a development or testing environment within a larger system.

methods.name: isLocalCheckEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the local check is enabled based on environment variables.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Checks if a specific flag or argument is present in the arguments list.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Modifies arguments and environment to apply local tsgo (possibly a type-checking or testing tool) policies.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Modifies arguments and environment to apply local oxlint (possibly a linting tool) policies.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a filesystem lock for heavy checks to prevent concurrent execution.

methods.name: resolveGitCommonDir
methods.description: Resolves the common directory of a Git repository.
